facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Instrutivo n.º 02/2025 of 13 August 2025, issued under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 of 16 December 2020 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos), sets value limits for cheques, Multicaixa network transactions, ATM withdrawals and card transfers and purchases for supervised financial institutions.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

systems.tiers: financial institutions supervised by the Banco Nacional de Angola

facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 1/26 of 28 January 2026, made under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 of 16 December 2020 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola), enters into force on publication and repeals Aviso n.º 15/22 on non-bank acquirers and sub-acquirers.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Aviso n.º 1/26 of 28 January 2026 provides that only payment service companies authorised by the Banco Nacional de Angola under Lei n.º 40/20 may act as non-bank acquirers of payment terminals (TPA) and ATMs.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Aviso n.º 1/26 of 28 January 2026, in force from publication, requires every non-bank acquirer to participate in the Multicaixa payment arrangement and be certified by the entity responsible for it, and bars a bank from refusing to represent a non-bank acquirer in interbank settlement.

Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 4/25 of 22 August 2025, made under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola), sets binding rules for opening, operating and closing e-money accounts by payment service providers that issue e-money, in force from publication.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 2/22 of 2 February 2022, made under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 of 16 December 2020 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola), sets the rules for access to payment service activity, including e-money issuance, and repeals Avisos n.º 5/14 and 7/17.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Aviso n.º 2/22 of 2 February 2022 lets non-bank financial institutions based in Angola provide payment services and defines a payment service company as a non-bank financial institution authorised by the Banco Nacional de Angola, with e-money issuance among the permitted services.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 8/17 of 12 September 2017, binding on operators of clearing and settlement subsystems, payment service providers and participants, entered into force on publication and replaced Aviso 11/15.

The Aviso rests on Lei n.º 5/05 of 29 July 2005, the Payment System Law of Angola, which it cites as the basis for BNA regulation and for the sanctions regime; the document gives no sign the law was repealed.
